descriptionInUI: Optional in-mission scripted air coordination for both sides. If an airborne, operating AWACS or a powered (Skynet IADS') command centre survives. Redirects available fight-capable aircrafts against detected enemies and interceptable cruise/anti-ship missiles. Also provides optional SAM avoidance and protective fighter evasion for all packages. F10 pause controls allow manual tasking.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Allow IMAC to command BLUE AI flights. Independent of the RED setting; Player/Client groups are never commanded.
Allow IMAC to command RED AI flights. Independent of the BLUE setting; Player/Client groups are never commanded.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Divert attacks and BARCAPs away from SAM threat rings
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Allow known SAM rings to hold or cancel attacks and limit BARCAP/TARCAP and returning-fighter interceptions. When disabled, IMAC ignores SAM rings for these flights. Terrain, fighter evasion and fuel limits are controlled separately.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Never divert DEAD/SEAD missions for SAM rings
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Never divert DEAD, SEAD, SEAD Escort or SEAD Sweep flights because of SAM threat rings. Fighter evasion and fuel limits still apply. Checked and disabled when SAM avoidance is off; editable when SAM avoidance is on.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Divert flights away from enemy fighters
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Move vulnerable flights into a safe orbit when detected enemy fighters approach. This controls protective evasion, not CAP interception or the flight's own attack tasks. Fuel limits and SAM avoidance remain separate.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Never divert Escort or Fighter Sweep away from fighters
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Never make Escort or Fighter Sweep flights evade enemy fighters: these missions are intended to engage them. Does not disable their native combat tasks or returning-fighter interception. Checked and disabled when fighter evasion is off; editable when fighter evasion is on.

Show decisions and rejection reasons to the owning coalition (at most four debug messages per minute). Also write detailed IMAC|DEBUG diagnostics to dcs.log, including command authority, active orders, fuel and remaining lease time. Independent of normal order reports; disabled sides generate no debug messages.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Show OPFOR debug messages on BLUE
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Mirror RED decisions, rejection reasons and active-order details to BLUE, with a separate limit of eight messages per minute. Requires debug and the RED commander; the BLUE commander need not be enabled. Routine status messages remain log-only.
Measured from the patrol station or, for a returning fighter, its position when the diversion began.
